result.summary: Found 1 significant navigation-state issue; the rest of the visible clipping appears consistent with intended horizontal scrolling or viewport boundaries.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights “Profile” in green even though the displayed screen is clearly the restaurant discovery/Home feed. “Home” is shown as inactive, creating a misleading navigation state.
issues.suggestion: Mark “Home” as the active tab on this screen and reserve the active “Profile” styling for the profile page.
